about: Every Suno take made for this reel, kept so prompts and results can be compared and unused takes reused. Audio lives in the suno-archive release (archive links); suno_url opens the original at full quality.

takes.title: Four Notes, Four Phases
takes.note: Counting motif under 4-25 s, opening joined to its own ending at about 25 s, final chord blooms just after 'Count them now'
takes.structure_cues:
[Instrumental]
[Intro: near silence, one glass harmonica note]
[Verse: plucked bass and kalimba begin counting, four notes, repeating]
[Verse 2: bowed vibraphone shimmer joins, still counting]
[Bridge: flugelhorn enters, one long warm phrase]
[Outro: full warm major chord, strings swell, clean ending]
[End]

prompts.title: Four Notes / Four Notes, Four Phases
prompts.style: A slow counting motif carries the whole track: soft plucked upright bass and muted kalimba repeat a patient four-note figure, like someone quietly counting. Bowed vibraphone and glass harmonica shimmer above it, warm and metallic, like gold catching light in dark stone. Dry, intimate, close-mic'd, a little room tone. Halfway, a low flugelhorn plays one long warm phrase. The ending opens into a full, sunlit major chord with soft strings and a brushed timpani swell, then stops cleanly on the downbeat. No piano, no drones, no choir, no vocals, no trap drums, no risers.
